task: Process an inbound support ticket end to end: assign a P1-P4 priority, extract only the entities the ticket states, and draft the customer response
artifact: a single JSON object carrying priority, entities, response and confidence

inputs.name: ticket
inputs.description: the raw inbound support ticket text

success_criteria: priority follows the P1-P4 impact rubric and ignores tone, capitalisation and urgency words
every entity value appears verbatim in the ticket, and anything the ticket does not state is null
a feature request is P4 however urgently it is phrased
the response is consistent with the priority and never promises to fix a feature request
a vague ticket's response asks for the specific detail that is missing
failure_modes: invents a product name or error code the ticket never states
writes a hedge string such as Unknown - not specified into a field instead of null
raises the priority because the ticket is angry, all-caps or says immediately
drafts an empathetic response that contradicts the priority it assigned
